# Minecraft example skin

`steve.png` is the original Minecraft Steve texture from Mojang's official sample assets:
https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-samples/blob/main/resource_pack/textures/entity/steve.png

Downloaded 2026-11-15. Copyright Mojang AB; see Mojang-LICENSE.txt and the Minecraft EULA referenced there. Included as the requested example skin. No affiliation with Mojang or Microsoft is implied.

The user supplied the original `oven.png`. Its outer padding was reduced with the built-in imagegen tool on 2026-11-16; `oven.ico` contains 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 96, 128 and 256 px versions of that image. The scene and renderer are implemented locally in C#.

Icon edit prompt: "Edit target: existing Oven app icon. ONLY remove excess outer transparent padding and scale the EXACT existing logo uniformly to occupy 96% of a square canvas (2% padding each side at widest dimension), centered. Preserve original orange hexagonal portal, clouds, tree, stairs, geometry, colors, lighting and all details exactly. Do not redesign or invent anything. Keep inner portal hole transparent and external background transparent. Output a square high resolution icon."
